title: 第1章 借用一下金丹
slug: 恶毒女配又装纯禁欲大佬皆沦陷
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“和铃，把你的金丹借我用一下。”

一道轻飘飘的嗓音响起，好像在说今天天气真不错一样，非常的自然。

和铃在心头咒骂了一声脑瘫。

哪来的神经病医院没关好，让他跑了出来。

金丹那不是修仙小说中才有的东西吗？

她倒是经常在网上冲浪，看见过有人把肾结石戏称为自己的金丹的。

和铃撑开眼皮子，淡淡说道：“想要金丹的话，就少喝水，多吃盐，减少运动多憋尿，金丹自然就练……”成了。

声音戛然而止。

和铃的眼瞳微微放大，愣了几秒。

闯入眼帘的是一个墨发白衣男子，虽眉目如画，却有些冷峻。

和铃感觉心脏跳动的速度有些异常地快。

下一秒，脑子肿胀得像是要爆炸。

【警告！警告！宿主对绑定目标口出恶言、态度恶劣，行为OOC，请及时改正！请及时改正！】

尖锐的警告声在和铃脑子里面响起，她顿时头皮发麻，身体不受控制地抖了几下。

“你是什么东西？”

和铃咬紧牙关，颤声逼问。

白衣男子皱了皱眉，“你在骂我？”

“和铃，就算我知道我这个请求有些为难人了，但你也不用骂人吧？”

“我只是借你的金丹用一下，又不是不还……你放心，我日后一定还你一颗无暇金丹。”

“你相信我……”

【警告！警告！宿主行为已OOC，请及时改正！】

和铃瞳孔骤缩，疯吼道：“闭嘴！！”

非常静。

夜弦被和铃这一吼，震惊到呆在了原地。

她怎么了？

“呼……”

吵闹的声音消停，和铃重重吐出了一口气。

她看向夜弦，“你是来干什么来着的？哦对，是来借金丹的……”

夜弦悲悯地蹙着眉头，“梁秋儿师姐正等着你的金丹救命，和铃你……”

“不借，快滚。”

【警告……】

告你祖宗！

和铃冷着脸，在心里骂道。

Page (1/3)

"He Ling, lend me your golden elixir."

A light voice sounded, as if saying that the weather is really nice today, it was very natural.

He Ling cursed cerebral palsy in his mind.

The mental hospital was not closed properly and he escaped.

Isn’t the golden elixir something only found in novels about cultivating immortals?

She often surfs the Internet and has seen people jokingly calling kidney stones their golden elixir.

He Ling opened his eyelids and said calmly: "If you want the golden elixir, drink less water, eat more salt, exercise less and hold your urine more, and you will naturally practice the golden elixir..." It was done.

The sound stopped suddenly.

He Ling's pupils dilated slightly and he was stunned for a few seconds.

What came into view was a man with dark hair and white clothes. Although his features were picturesque, he was a bit cold.

He Ling felt that his heart was beating abnormally fast.

The next second, his brain swelled as if it was going to explode.

【warn!warn!The host speaks evil words, has a bad attitude, and behaves OOC towards the bound target. Please correct it in time!Please correct it in time!】

A sharp warning sounded in He Ling's head. Her scalp suddenly became numb and her body shook uncontrollably.

"What are you?"

He Ling gritted his teeth and asked with a trembling voice.

The man in white frowned, "Are you scolding me?"

"He Ling, even though I know my request is a bit embarrassing, you don't have to curse, right?"

"I'm just borrowing your golden elixir for a little while, it's not like I won't return it... Don't worry, I will definitely return you a flawless golden elixir in the future."

"You believe me..."

【Warning!warn!The host behavior is OOC, please correct it in time!】

He Ling's pupils shrank suddenly, and she shouted wildly: "Shut up!!"

Very quiet.

Ye Xian was so shocked by He Ling's roar that he froze in place.

What happened to her?

"Huh..."

The noisy sound stopped, and He Ling let out a heavy breath.

She looked at Ye Xian, "What are you here for? Oh yes, you are here to borrow the golden elixir..."

Ye Xian frowned pitifully, "Senior Sister Liang Qiu'er is waiting for your golden elixir to save her life, and Ling you..."

"If you don't want to borrow it, get out of here."

【Warning...】

Sue your ancestors!

He Ling had a cold face and cursed in his heart.
